LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Legion_Novice_1: {PAWN} put down a small band of profligate scavengers squatting near the frontier and left their gear for the Legion.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Legion_Novice_2: {PAWN} walked the river line, chased off a handful of stragglers, and came back with nothing worth reporting to a Centurion.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Legion_Novice_3: {PAWN} rounded up a small camp of unaligned settlers and marched them back for judgment.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Legion_Novice_4: {PAWN} spent the raid burning out a den of raiders who'd been picking off caravans.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Legion_Veteran_1: {PAWN} broke a settlement that had refused tribute and made sure word of it reached the next town over.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Legion_Veteran_2: {PAWN} hunted down a band of deserters and dealt with them the way the Legion deals with cowards.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Legion_Veteran_3: {PAWN} spent the campaign mapping a stretch of contested ground, marking it fit for the next legion to hold.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Legion_Veteran_4: {PAWN} came back with a cracked shield and a line of new slaves in tow.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Legion_Elite_1: {PAWN} went in alone where a century would have drawn too much attention, and left nothing standing.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Legion_Elite_2: {PAWN} ran the operation exactly as ordered - in, break the resistance, out before word could spread.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Legion_Elite_3: {PAWN} spent the better part of two weeks deep in contested territory and returned with intelligence Caesar will want to hear.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Legion_Elite_4: {PAWN} didn't say much about what happened out there, just delivered the report and asked for new orders.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Legion_Sentinel_1: {PAWN} pushed past the edge of any territory the Legion holds, charting ground for the next conquest.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Legion_Sentinel_2: {PAWN} came back from unclaimed land with a full report and word of a region ready to kneel or burn.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Legion_Sentinel_3: {PAWN} spent nearly two weeks beyond contact and returned with news that will matter to Caesar himself.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Legion_Sentinel_4: {PAWN} walked back into the Fort carrying proof of what was found at the edge of the map, dust and blood in equal measure.
